translations.web: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;
translations.bsb: Be careful not to make a treaty with the inhabitants of the land you are entering, lest they become a snare in your midst.
translations.kjv: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst
translations.asv: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
